source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atomic spectra (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Atomic spectra tab dikhte hain jab atoms khaas wavelengths ki roshni chhorte ya jazb karte hain: yeh emission aur absorption spectra hain. Yeh is baat ka saboot hain ke atoms mein electrons sirf muqarrara (discrete) tawanai ki satahon ke darmiyan ja sakte hain. Tawanai jazb kar ke electrons neeche se oopar ki satahon par jate hain; phir excited electrons neeche lautte hue tawanai chhorte aur emission spectrum banate hain.

items: Emission spectrum kam pressure wali gas ko garam kar ke banta hai. Jab electron neeche ki satah par girta hai to aisa photon chhorta hai jis ki wavelength tawanai ke farq ke barabar ho, is liye spectrum kaale pas manzar par alag alag rangeen lakeeron ka set hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaali patti par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par chaar rangeen lakeerein, mehwar Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: tawanai ki satahein n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 3 (gulabi), n = 4 (halka neela) aur n = 5 (gehra neela) se n = 2 tak teen mote neeche jaate teer; har aik se usi rang ka lehar-numa photon baen taraf nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.2: Hydrogen ka emission spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer aik electron ka oopar ki satah se n = 2 par girna hai, aur har girne par aik photon (lehar-numa teer) nikalta hai. Jitna bara farq (gap), utni zyada tawanai aur utni chhoti wavelength: n = 3 se n = 2 surkh 656 nm lakeer deta hai, n = 4 se n = 2 neeli-hari 486 nm, aur n = 5 se n = 2 neeli 434 nm. Patti mein chauthi lakeer 410 nm n = 6 se n = 2 se aati hai; kitab ka khaaka sirf teen teer dikhata hai.

items: Absorption spectrum safaid roshni ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas se guzar kar banta hai. Sirf woh photons jazb hote hain jin ki tawanai electrons ko excite karne ke bilkul barabar ho, is liye spectrum musalsal patti hai jis par kaali lakeerein hain. Kaali lakeerein usi unsar ke emission spectrum ki chamakdar lakeeron ki wavelengths par hain: absorption spectrum emission spectrum ka photographic negative jaisa hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: banafshi se surkh tak musalsal rangeen patti jis par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par kaali lakeerein hain, mehwar Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: satahein n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 2 se n = 3 (gulabi), n = 4 (halka neela) aur n = 5 (gehra neela) tak teen mote oopar jaate teer; har teer tak usi rang ka lehar-numa photon baen taraf se aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.3: Hydrogen ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Absorption mein ulta hota hai: safaid roshni ke wohi photons jazb hote hain jin ki tawanai kisi gap ke barabar ho, aur electron n = 2 se oopar chala jata hai. Isi liye rangeen patti mein bilkul unhi wavelengths (410, 434, 486, 656 nm) par kaali lakeerein hain jahan emission mein chamakdar lakeerein thin.

blocks.prompt: Kisi unsar ke absorption spectrum mein kaali lakeerein us ke emission spectrum ki chamakdar lakeeron ki wavelengths par kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono unhi muqarrara satahon ke darmiyan chhalangon se aati hain; absorption electron ko farq par oopar le jati aur emission usi farq par wapas lati hai, is liye photon ki tawanai aur wavelengths aik hain.

items: Emission: kaale par chamakdar lakeerein (electrons girte); absorption: musalsal spectrum par kaali lakeerein (electrons charhte).
Lakeerein muqarrara tawanai ki satahein dikhati; hydrogen ki lakeerein 410, 434, 486, 656 nm.
